verdict.rationale: Expensify ships automations such as workspace rules, auto-submit, auto-approve and auto-export, so versioning and rollback is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has nothing on version history, change review, or rolling back rules or workflows. The closest item, 'fix your own setup mistakes by just asking' via the AI assistant, is an adjacent conversational edit feature, not versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
